<script>
jQuery(document).ready(function () {

    //Buscar no Estoque
    base_url = "https://autonomistasautoshopping.com.br/";
    
    //ATRASAR CARREGAMENTOS
    //atrasa o carregamento do mapa
    $('.mapa1').html('<div class="d-flex justify-content-center"><div class="spinner-border" role="status"><span class="sr-only">Carregando...</span></div></div>');
    setTimeout(function(){ $('.mapa1').html('<iframe class="lazyload embed-responsive-item" title="Mapa do local no Google Maps" src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!4v1777392634064!6m8!1m7!1sCAoSHENJQUJJaERvZUlwcjIyd1FyZF9OeUtGOUJleUI.!2m2!1d-23.5438608!2d-46.7637274!3f347.52887595190583!4f1.1675525959189912!5f0.7820865974627469" width="600" height="450" style="border:0; pointer-events:none;" loading="lazy" referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"></iframe>'); }, 6000);

    //Navbar Mini
    $(window).scroll(function() {
        if ($(this).scrollTop() > 100) {
            $('.navbar-fixed-top').addClass('navbar-min');
            $('.topo').addClass('d-none');
        } else {
            $('.navbar-fixed-top').removeClass('navbar-min');
            $('.topo').removeClass('d-none');
         }
    });

}); //ready
</script>

<script>
jQuery(function ($) {
    function getAjaxUrl(url) {
        if (!url) {
            return url;
        }

        return url + (url.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') + 'ajax=1';
    }

    function setProcuraVeiculoState(sent) {
        window.procuraVeiculoEnviada = !!sent;

        try {
            sessionStorage.setItem('procuraVeiculoEnviada', sent ? '1' : '0');
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    function isProcuraVeiculoStateSent() {
        if (typeof window.procuraVeiculoEnviada !== 'undefined') {
            return !!window.procuraVeiculoEnviada;
        }

        try {
            return sessionStorage.getItem('procuraVeiculoEnviada') === '1';
        } catch (e) {}

        return false;
    }

    function applyProcuraVeiculoBannerState() {
        var $banner = $('#lead-busca-veiculo');

        if (!$banner.length) {
            return;
        }

        var sent = isProcuraVeiculoStateSent();

        $banner.toggleClass('is-success', sent);
        $banner.find('.lead-busca-intro').toggle(!sent);
        $banner.find('.lead-busca-sucesso').toggle(sent);
    }

    function updateEstoque(url, pushUrl, afterUpdate) {
        var $resultado = $('#resultado-estoque');

        if (!$resultado.length || !url) {
            return;
        }

        $.ajax({
            url: getAjaxUrl(url),
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'json',
            cache: false
        }).done(function (response) {
            if (response && response.html) {
                $resultado.replaceWith(response.html);
                applyProcuraVeiculoBannerState();

                if (pushUrl && window.history && window.history.pushState) {
                    window.history.pushState({ estoque: true }, '', url);
                }

                if (typeof afterUpdate === 'function') {
                    afterUpdate();
                }
            }
        }).fail(function () {
            window.location.href = url;
        });
    }

    function updateQueryStringParameter(url, key, value) {
        var baseUrl = url.split('?')[0];
        var queryString = url.indexOf('?') !== -1 ? url.split('?')[1] : '';
        var params = [];
        var found = false;

        if (queryString) {
            $.each(queryString.split('&'), function (_, part) {
                if (!part) {
                    return;
                }

                var pieces = part.split('=');
                var paramKey = decodeURIComponent(pieces[0] || '');

                if (paramKey === key) {
                    found = true;
                    if (value !== '') {
                        params.push(encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value));
                    }
                } else {
                    params.push(part);
                }
            });
        }

        if (!found && value !== '') {
            params.push(encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value));
        }

        return baseUrl + (params.length ? '?' + params.join('&') : '');
    }

    function scrollToVehicleResults() {
        var target = document.getElementById('inicio-veiculos');

        if (!target) {
            target = document.querySelector('#resultado-estoque .item');
        }

        if (!target) {
            target = document.querySelector('#resultado-estoque .card');
        }

        if (!target) {
            target = document.getElementById('resultado-estoque');
        }

        if (!target) {
            return;
        }

        var top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 120;
        window.scrollTo({
            top: Math.max(0, top),
            behavior: 'smooth'
        });
    }

    function submitEstoqueForm($form) {
        var action = $form.attr('action') || window.location.href;
        var query = $form.serialize();
        var url = action + (query ? (action.indexOf('?') === -1 ? '?' : '&') + query : '');

        setProcuraVeiculoState(false);
        updateEstoque(url, true, function () {
            setTimeout(scrollToVehicleResults, 150);
        });
    }

    function parseAjaxJsonResponse(responseText) {
        var text = responseText || '';

        if (typeof text !== 'string') {
            return text;
        }

        text = text.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();

        if (!text) {
            return null;
        }

        try {
            return JSON.parse(text);
        } catch (e) {
            var start = text.indexOf('{');
            var end = text.lastIndexOf('}');

            if (start !== -1 && end !== -1 && end > start) {
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(text.slice(start, end + 1));
                } catch (e2) {}
            }

            return null;
        }
    }

    $(document).on('submit', '#form-busca-estoque', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        submitEstoqueForm($(this));
    });

    $(document).on('change', '#ordenar-estoque', function () {
        var value = $(this).val();
        var url = updateQueryStringParameter(window.location.href, 'ordenar', value);

        $('#ordenar-form').val(value);
        updateEstoque(url, true, false);
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#abrir-procura-veiculo', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        if ($('#modalProcuraVeiculo').length) {
            $('#modalProcuraVeiculo').modal('show');
        }
    });

    $(document).on('shown.bs.modal', '#modalProcuraVeiculo', function () {
        $('#procura-origem').val(window.location.href);
        $('#resultado-procura').hide().removeClass('alert-success alert-danger').text('');

    });

    $(document).on('submit', '#form-procura-veiculo', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        var $form = $(this);
        var $feedback = $('#resultado-procura');
        var $button = $form.find('button[type="submit"]');

        $('#procura-origem').val(window.location.href);
        $button.prop('disabled', true);
        $feedback.hide().removeClass('alert-success alert-danger').text('');

        $.ajax({
            url: $form.attr('action'),
            type: 'POST',
            data: $form.serialize(),
            dataType: 'text'
        }).done(function (responseText) {
            var response = parseAjaxJsonResponse(responseText);

            if (response && response.status) {
                setProcuraVeiculoState(true);
                $feedback.addClass('alert-success').text(response.message || 'Mensagem enviada com sucesso.').show();
                $form[0].reset();
                $('#procura-origem').val(window.location.href);
                $('#modalProcuraVeiculo').one('hidden.bs.modal', function () {
                    applyProcuraVeiculoBannerState();

                    var $banner = $('#lead-busca-veiculo');
                    if ($banner.length) {
                        $('html, body').animate({
                            scrollTop: Math.max(0, $banner.offset().top - 90)
                        }, 220);
                    }
                });
                $('#modalProcuraVeiculo').modal('hide');
            } else {
                $feedback.addClass('alert-danger').text((response && response.message) ? response.message : 'Não foi possível enviar sua mensagem.').show();
            }
        }).fail(function () {
            $feedback.addClass('alert-danger').text('Não foi possível enviar sua mensagem no momento.').show();
        }).always(function () {
            $button.prop('disabled', false);

        });
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#resultado-estoque .pagination a, #resultado-estoque .pagination-lista a', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        updateEstoque($(this).attr('href'), true);
    });

    applyProcuraVeiculoBannerState();

    $(window).on('popstate', function () {
        if ($('#resultado-estoque').length) {
            updateEstoque(window.location.href, false);
        }
    });

    if ('scrollRestoration' in window.history) {
        window.history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
    }
});
</script>



    <!-- Global site tag (gtag.js) - Google Analytics -->
    <script async="" src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=UA-166790892-1"></script>
    <script>
    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
    gtag('js', new Date());
    gtag('config', 'UA-166790892-1');
    </script>

    <script>
    (function () {
        function getClosestTrackingElement(element) {
            if (!element || !element.closest) {
                return null;
            }

            return element.closest('[data-ga4-event], [data-loja], [data-veiculo]');
        }

        function getGa4Params(element) {
            var getAttribute = element && element.getAttribute ? element.getAttribute.bind(element) : function () { return ''; };

            return {
                location: getAttribute('data-location') || 'autonomistas_vitrine_lojas',
                nome_loja: getAttribute('data-loja') || '',
                modelo_carro: getAttribute('data-veiculo') || '',
                marca_carro: getAttribute('data-marca') || '',
                id_loja: getAttribute('data-loja-id') || ''
            };
        }

        function trackGa4Event(eventName, params) {
            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
            window.dataLayer.push(Object.assign({ event: eventName }, params));

            if (typeof window.gtag === 'function') {
                window.gtag('event', eventName, params);
            }
        }

        function prepareGa4Params(element) {
            var params = getGa4Params(element);

            window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
            window.dataLayer.push(Object.assign({ event: 'autonomistas_lead_params' }, params));

            return params;
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            var trackingElement = getClosestTrackingElement(event.target);

            if (trackingElement) {
                prepareGa4Params(trackingElement);
            }
        }, true);

        document.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
            var form = event.target;

            if (form && form.getAttribute('data-ga4-event') === 'form_submit') {
                prepareGa4Params(form);
            }
        }, true);

        document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            var whatsappLink = event.target.closest('[data-ga4-event="lead_whatsapp_click"]');

            if (!whatsappLink) {
                return;
            }

            var params = prepareGa4Params(whatsappLink);

            trackGa4Event('lead_whatsapp_click', params);
            trackGa4Event('click_whatsapp', params);
        });

        document.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
            var form = event.target;

            if (!form || form.getAttribute('data-ga4-event') !== 'form_submit' || form.__ga4Submitting) {
                return;
            }

            event.preventDefault();

            var submitted = false;
            var submitForm = function () {
                if (submitted) {
                    return;
                }

                submitted = true;
                form.__ga4Submitting = true;
                form.submit();
            };
            var params = prepareGa4Params(form);

            params.transport_type = 'beacon';
            params.event_callback = submitForm;

            trackGa4Event('form_submit', params);
            window.setTimeout(submitForm, 700);
        });
    })();
    </script>
